_comment: NOT part of the green contract, and re-checked 2026-09-12 after V4's archive-member arm landed: BOTH STILL SURVIVE, which is correct. They are about the export's BYTE SOURCE, and the member arm never reaches it -- a deferred member is described, not read. The source is consulted only for content of a loaded base image, and this module has no host blob store and a fresh build has no base files, so it is unreachable by construction here. They become killable when the export can serialize a DERIVED build (V4 item 2, the BaseSource::Host arm, plus a real byte source), not merely when V4 has started landing. Move them into sffs-module-abi.json then -- they are the tests that will prove it.
